text:
Aria: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem / sharing owners for GPU capacity & autoscale fixes. Keep updates short here.
Mateo: I'll take scheduler tuning. Plan: increase scaleDown stabilization, add packing heuristic to limit fragmentation, and run a 24h canary on lowest-traffic shard. Target promote: 2026-04-06.
Sasha: I'll own quota + finance coordination. Two asks: short emergency buffer (+12% for 7 days) and a conservative reserve commit (+10%). Opening ticket now.
Kenji: I'll update runbooks and the on-call playbook (quick-reserve commands + rollback). Also adding a decision tree for when to redirect to smaller model variants.
Mateo: Staging HPA snippet I'm testing:
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
behavior:
  scaleDown:
    stabilizationWindowSeconds: 420
metrics:
  - type: Pods
    pods:
      metric:
        name: gpu_utilization
      target:
        type: AverageValue
        averageValue: "72"
```
Mateo: This should avoid oscillations from short-lived batch spikes.
Aria: Add a 24h canary requirement before any wider rollout. Also add a post-canary checklist.
Sasha: capacity-bot created ticket https://redwood.local/tickets/INC-4810 (emergency buffer) and TASK-9607 (scheduler canary).
capacity-bot: Reminder: INC-4810 created by Sasha; status: awaiting finance review. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Kenji: Observability ask: add pool_headroom_ratio and free_gpus_per_pool to Console. Also propose a daily slack report of pools with headroom < 15%.
Mateo: I can add metrics and a dashboard tile. Target metric deploy: 2026-03-31, alert wiring: 2026-04-01.
Aria: Owners & dates recap: Mateo - scheduler canary & metrics (canary 2026-04-02, promote 2026-04-06), Sasha - quota ticket (2026-03-29) + reserve PR (2026-04-09), Kenji - runbook & playbook (2026-03-28). I'll set a 15m closure check for 2026-04-07.
Sasha: If quota is delayed, fallback is to gate large nightly embeddings (label: schedule=offpeak) and temporarily route non-critical traffic to fallback models for up to 72h. Adding notes to INC-4810.
Mateo: Also proposing a 48h weekend surge sim to validate preemption and headroom. I'm tentatively scheduling for weekend 2026-04-04. Need capacity oncall + jobs team.
Kenji: I'll prepare a post-sim template to capture failures, preemptions, and p99 regressions.
Aria: Capacity-bot, please add TASK-9608 (surge-sim) and TASK-9609 (runbook PR).
capacity-bot: Action tracker updated: INC-4810, TASK-9607, TASK-9608, TASK-9609.
Mateo: Starting the staging canary this afternoon, will report quick telemetry.
Sasha: Filing finance justification now.
Kenji: Will open runbook PR after adding example traces.
Aria: Thanks all — put blockers here. If none, :thumbsup: and I'll mark these in the tracker and run the closure check on 04/07.
